problem_statement: Arrow issue #535 reports that arrow.get('20171017', ['YYYY.M.D']) leaks ValueError instead of raising ParserError. Preserve the parser exception boundary by converting invalid candidate date construction failures into ParserError.

files.tests/test_arrow_parser.py:
import pytest

from arrow_parser import ParserError, get


def test_invalid_multiformat_date_raises_parser_error():
    with pytest.raises(ParserError):
        get('20171017', ['YYYY.M.D'])


def test_valid_date_still_parses():
    assert get('20171017', ['YYYYMMDD']) == (2017, 10, 17)
